items.difficulty_reason: Perfect test objects suffice for pseudo-coherence of RGamma(X, E ⊗ K): fixes the cohomological dimension N and the upper bound b of K, approximates a pseudo-coherent E by a perfect P of (X, E, m-N-1-b) (approximation theorem), and controls the cone: C ⊗ K has cohomology vanishing above m-N-1, so RGamma(X, C ⊗ K) vanishes above m-1, making RGamma(X, P ⊗ K) -> RGamma(X, E ⊗ K) an isomorphism on cohomology in degrees >= m; the source is pseudo-coherent by hypothesis, so the target is m-pseudo-coherent for every m.
